translation.title: Mupirocin Ointment
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, folliculitis, furunculosis (boils), and infected eczema, and for bacterial skin infections of wounds and burns, caused by most skin-infection bacteria including Staphylococcus aureus (including methicillin-resistant strains), other staphylococci and streptococci, and by Gram-negative bacteria such as E. coli and Haemophilus influenzae.
translation.usage: Apply a small amount to the infected area 2 to 3 times a day for 10 days. If needed, the treated area may be covered with a dressing or sealed.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to other ointments containing polyethylene glycol or have reacted to them before, if you have kidney disease, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Do not use it for a long time on open lacerated wounds or damaged skin. Be careful not to get it in the eyes. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it on mucous membranes such as the eyes or nose. Do not use it at a site where central venous cannulation will be performed. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if adverse reactions occur, such as skin hypersensitivity reactions including a burning sensation, stinging or pain, itching, a rash and erythema (red spots), at times nausea, dry skin, tenderness, swelling, contact dermatitis or increased exudate, and rarely systemic allergic reactions.
